title: Verify STE and bot-slop checks coexist via checks gating
description: Add a validation scenario proving an STE profile can enable or disable individual bot-slop checks and STE checks independently, mirroring the checks mapping contract in README (unknown keys fail profile validation).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Coexistence proven: exclusive=true gates every bot-slop heuristic block off in diagnose_draft; default mode leaves them untouched. Gherkin STE-only and beside scenarios cover both directions; tests/test_asd_ste100_plugin.py asserts kinds.
